drafts.subject: Goods receipt check: PO 4500012169 line 10 (invoice PPF-03558)
drafts.body:
Hi team,

Portarlington Packaging Films has invoiced PPF-03558 ($5,702.40 inc GST) against PO 4500012169 line 10, CPP sealant film 30um x 1000mm, for 18 rolls.

Our records show 18 rolls received on this line so far, and those have already been invoiced. This invoice bills a further 18 rolls with no goods receipt.

Could you please check whether this second delivery of 18 rolls has arrived?
- If it has, please post the goods receipt against PO 4500012169 line 10 so AP can pay the invoice.
- If it hasn't arrived, please let us know and AP will query the vendor.

Thanks,
Accounts Payable
